svg.title: Animation of the seven steps of a QR sign-in: the phone scans the QR code, opens a tunnel, announces itself over Bluetooth, the browser and the phone exchange a handshake through the tunnel, the browser asks for a signature and the phone sends it, after which the browser is signed in.

g.text: The phone scans the QR code and derives keys
The phone opens a tunnel at the relay server
Bluetooth: “I am nearby, meet me there”
The browser joins and starts the handshake
The phone answers: end-to-end encrypted now
The browser asks: “sign this?” You unlock
The phone sends the signature: signed in!
